gaps.sentence: All ___ must wear identity badges at all times on site.
gaps.explanation: 'Personnel' = the employees of an organisation; 'personal' is an adjective.

gaps.sentence: The sensor is extremely ___ to changes in temperature.
gaps.explanation: 'Sensitive to' reacts readily to something; 'sensible' means showing good judgement.

gaps.sentence: The city archive preserves ___ maps of the harbour from the 1700s.
gaps.explanation: 'Historical' describes things connected with the study of the past; 'historic' means momentous.

gaps.sentence: The committee ___ of eight members and two advisers.
gaps.explanation: 'Consist of' = be made up of; 'composes of' is wrong.

gaps.sentence: ___ of the film, the hero rides off into the sunset.
gaps.hint: the final part of something (film, book, street)
gaps.explanation: 'At the end of something' refers to the final part; 'in the end' means finally, after a process.

gaps.sentence: Take my ___ and sell the car before the prices fall.
gaps.explanation: 'Take my advice' — the noun form follows the possessive.

gaps.sentence: The government’s ___ policy has divided economists.
gaps.explanation: 'Economic' relates to the economy; 'economical' means saving money.

gaps.sentence: Please ___ me to post this letter.
gaps.hint: make somebody not forget: ___ somebody to do something
gaps.explanation: 'Remind somebody to do something' means to make someone remember; 'remember' is something you do yourself.
